subject: Next steps: lock deep-dive + evaluation kickoff (proposed plan & success criteria)
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@wellivia.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2024-04-11T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: lock deep-dive + evaluation kickoff (proposed plan & success criteria)

Hi Amy — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and two asks so we can move quickly to an evaluation kickoff:

Recap (brief):
- Primary goal: reduce clinical documentation time for care coordinators by ~30% while keeping accuracy above 92%.
- Key workflows: discharge summaries + referral triage + templated patient follow-ups.
- Success signals: latency < 150ms per generation for short prompts, >92% NER recall on sampled prompts, and 80% QA acceptance rate across pilot cases.

Asks / next steps:
1) Lock a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive (engineering + security) where we can validate data flows and infra needs. Proposed slots (PDT):
   - Tue Apr 16, 10:00–11:15am
   - Wed Apr 17, 1:00–2:15pm
2) Schedule the evaluation kickoff (45–60m) to review the trial plan, success criteria, and prompt set/evals. Preferably the same week as the deep-dive or the following week.

Prep we’ll bring: trial plan draft (attached), example prompt pack, evaluation metrics template, and a short mutual action plan link. To make the deep-dive efficient, could you confirm:
- Who from Wellivia should join the technical call (security, data engineer, product owner)?
- Are there any procurement or contracting constraints to surface now?
- Will you be able to share a 50–200-row sample of de-identified notes for prompt tuning (S3/secure transfer or Drive)?

I’ve attached the trial plan draft (Wellivia_trial_plan_v1.pdf) and my discovery notes. If neither slot works, send a couple of alternatives and we’ll lock one.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0173
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Wellivia_trial_plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 180KB)
Attachment: Discovery_notes_Wellivia.odt (ODT, 35KB)

From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@wellivia.com>

Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@wellivia.com>, procurement@wellivia.com
Date: 2024-04-11T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: lock deep-dive + evaluation kickoff (proposed plan & success criteria)

Thanks Sofia — great summary and appreciated. Wed Apr 17, 1:00–2:15pm works best for our engineering lead (Tom) and me. For the kickoff, can we aim for Friday Apr 19, 11:00–11:45am? That gives us time to sync internally after the deep-dive.

Attendees we’ll bring to the deep-dive: Tom Blake (eng lead), Me (product), and I’ll try to have someone from security join — if not, they will attend the kickoff. Procurement looped in above to start a parallel thread if needed.

Regarding sample data: we can share a de-identified 150-row sample (CSV) via secure Drive by EOD Thu Apr 18. Any preferred schema/format? Also, are you able to sign a standard NDA or data processing addendum first?

Appreciate the attachment — we’ll review and come prepared with initial success criteria feedback.

Best,
Amy Chen
Product Manager | Wellivia Health
amy.chen@wellivia.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@wellivia.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2024-04-12T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: lock deep-dive + evaluation kickoff (proposed plan & success criteria)

Hi Amy — thanks, glad Wed the 17th works. A couple quick items from an eng/security perspective so we can make the 1:15 window productive:

1) Access & data sample: CSV with columns (note_id, note_text, encounter_type, deid_hash) is ideal. Please remove PHI and include a quick legend for encounter_type values. S3 presigned URL or Drive link both OK.
2) Infrastructure checklist for the deep-dive:
   - High-level architecture: how will data be ingested (SFTP/S3/API)?
   - Network constraints: are you behind a VPC with private peering needs?
   - Tokenization/throughput targets: expected requests per second during peak pilot?
3) Trial plan tweaks: I attached a technical annex with the configuration we’ll spin up for a 2-week pilot (quantized model variant, prefix caching for templated docs, evaluation harness).

Draft success criteria (technical):
- Generation latency p50 < 120ms, p95 < 300ms for prompts < 512 tokens.
- Prompt-level accuracy: >=92% for NER fields tested across 200 examples.
- End-to-end throughput: sustain 20 reqs/sec with 95th percentile latency under SLO with batching enabled.

I’ve uploaded the technical annex as well and linked a mutual action plan outline here: https://app.redwood.ai/mutual-action-plan/RDW-2024-489

If you confirm attendees and the sample data timeline, I’ll block the calendar and share a meeting invite with an agenda.

–Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: TrialPlan_Technical_Annex.pdf (PDF, 95KB)
